rows.grounds: numeral indicating the set of eight accomplishments
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulaṃ (root Kaula)

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula practice for attaining the eight siddhis?
premises: The eight accomplishments are under consideration
Attainment of these accomplishments is identified with the root Kaula
items.inference: The root Kaula is the means by which the eight siddhis are attained
uncertainties: The specific eight siddhis are not enumerated in this verse
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
